scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src frontend/tests backend/src backend/test *.json *.js *.md frontend/*.js frontend/*.json frontend/*.html backend/*.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend/src frontend/tests backend/src backend/test *.json *.js *.md frontend/*.js frontend/*.json frontend/*.html backend/*.json
